post.description: Execute a read-only SQL query against public views.
post.response_shape: Object with columns (array of column names) and rows (array of arrays of values).
notes: May return paginated results for large queries.
Public views include v_source_snapshots and published collection views.
Use LIMIT/OFFSET for pagination with ORDER BY a stable key.

pagination_convention.strategy: Increment offset by limit until fewer than limit rows are returned.

snapshot_status_priority.rule: Select CERTIFIED when available; fall back to PROVISIONAL; never use STALE as authoritative.
